industry_solar.title:
Optimizing Renewable Assets and
Market Strategies
industry_solar.heading: The solar energy industry is growing rapidly, driven by environmental goals, technology, and decarbonization efforts. Datum Consulting helps solar enterprises optimize their investments through advanced technologies and data-driven strategies that address challenges in energy dispatch, market pricing, and scalable platforms.

items.title: Navigating the Dynamic Solar Energy Market
items.content:
The traditional energy market was not built for the variability of renewables or the flexibility offered by battery storage. Solar farms and battery manufacturers face a critical need for sophisticated tools to:

  • • Accurately forecast solar generation and demand.
  • • Intelligently manage battery charging and discharging cycles.
  • • Optimize energy sales to the grid based on real-time and predicted market prices.
  • • Simulate various operational and commercial scenarios to de-risk investments.
  • • Harness immense volumes of operational and market data for strategic insights.

Balancing battery storage, grid energy sales, and battery health optimization requires Machine Learning to handle diverse data like weather, peak usage, and seasonal variations for efficient solar energy trading.

items.title:
Our Approach: Advanced Analytics and Cloud-Based Platforms for
Solar Optimization
items.content: Datum Consulting collaborates with solar innovators, merging expertise in cloud engineering, machine learning, and big data to create technologies optimizing renewable energy management and next-generation solutions.

PremierBanking.title: Call for Change
PremierBanking.content: Facing security vulnerabilities, governance challenges, and the need for a digital refresh, a leading bank embarked on a Landing Zone transformation with Datum Consulting. By implementing an AWS Landing Zone and EKS Workload Platform, the bank achieved seamless cloud migration, cost optimization, and regulatory compliance. This modernized infrastructure enabled secure multi-tenancy hosting, automated pipelines, and efficient deployment of banking microservices, powering the Better Banking Experience (BBX) initiative.

PlatformCustomization.title: Call for Change
PlatformCustomization.content: A prestigious banking partner needed a secure, scalable platform for their enterprise microservices. Datum Consulting delivered a customized Amazon EKS workload platform, ensuring high availability, security, and compliance with industry standards. This platform supports the bank's digital transformation, enabling rapid deployment of new services and enhancing customer experiences.

tech_meets_banking.title: When Tech Meets Banking Excellence
items: The bank faces critical challenges in security, resource management, and compliance, hindering its digital transformation.
AWS Landing Zone provides a scalable, secure foundation to streamline governance, automate infrastructure deployment, and enforce best practices

By integrating structured controls, centralized auditing, and optimized resource allocation, the bank can modernize digital channels, accelerate innovation, and ensure seamless adoption of next-generation banking solutions.

valuable_difference.title: A Valuable Difference
valuable_difference.content: The project successfully eliminated security vulnerabilities, enforced role-based access and least privilege policies, and ensured full alignment with Philippine banking regulations. Automated CI/CD pipelines and zero-downtime deployments accelerated innovation, while provisioning 30+ environments streamlined workload management. Large on-prem applications were seamlessly migrated, supporting BBX initiatives such as frontend modernization and backend-for-frontend integration. With 99.9% platform uptime, optimized resource utilization, and significantly reduced manual efforts, the bank is now equipped for sustained growth. Datum Consulting has become a strategic, long-term partner, continuously supporting new migrations and future banking advancements.

lessons_learned.title: Lessons Learned
lessons_learned.content: A key takeaway from this initiative was the importance of strong collaboration between the bank and its third-party technology providers to prevent misalignment and delays. The integration of off-the-shelf banking products proved more complex than anticipated, requiring additional customization and effort to meet the bank’s operational needs. Through this experience, the bank has strengthened its approach to vendor engagement and technology adoption, ensuring greater agility and efficiency in future transformation initiatives.
